name: Significant tornado (STP ≥ 1)
description: Significant Tornado Parameter (effective layer) ≥ 1 — SPC's operational threshold above which significant (EF2+) tornadoes become climatologically favored. STP is a multiplicative composite of MLCAPE, ESRH, EBWD, MLLCL, and MLCIN, so it bakes in most of the WFO Louisville hodograph/thermo checklist in one number. Starting point — tune across cycles.
